<style id="vittorio-elementor-core-css">
/* ==========================================================================
   VITTORIO MILANO — THE ARTISTRY OF BESPOKE
   Core Stylesheet & Design System
   Architected for 100% WordPress / Elementor Compatibility
   ========================================================================== */

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   01. DESIGN TOKENS & CSS VARIABLES
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
:root {
  /* Color Palette — Deep Royal Burgundy #600C03, Warm Ivory, Muted Gold */
  --color-burgundy-dark: #380601;
  --color-burgundy: #600C03;
  --color-burgundy-medium: #4D0902;
  --color-burgundy-light: #7D1206;

  /* Luxury Gradient Tokens featuring #600C03 */
  --gradient-burgundy: linear-gradient(135deg, #600C03 0%, #350501 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-dark: linear-gradient(145deg, #3D0601 0%, #1A0200 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-radial: radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 20%, #781004 0%, #600C03 45%, #220300 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-card: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(96, 12, 3, 0.75) 0%, rgba(35, 5, 1, 0.92) 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-card-hover: linear-gradient(145deg, rgba(122, 18, 5, 0.9) 0%, rgba(60, 7, 2, 0.98) 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-btn: linear-gradient(135deg, #600C03 0%, #3D0601 100%);
  --gradient-burgundy-btn-hover: linear-gradient(135deg, #7D1206 0%, #600C03 100%);

  --color-ivory-light: #FAF8F1;
  --color-ivory: #F4EEDC;
  --color-ivory-muted: #EAE2CF;
  --color-ivory-border: #E2D9C3;

  --color-gold: #C9A45C;
  --color-gold-light: #DFBF7A;
  --color-gold-dark: #A5813A;
  --color-gold-subtle: rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.15);
  --color-gold-border: rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.3);

  --color-text-dark: #281A18;
  --color-text-muted: #756C62;
  --color-text-light: #FAF8F1;
  --color-text-ivory-subtle: #C4BBB0;

  --color-border-dark: rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.2);
  --color-border-light: rgba(80, 50, 30, 0.12);

  /* Typography */
  --font-serif: 'Cormorant Garamond', 'Playfair Display', Georgia, serif;
  --font-sans: 'Montserrat', 'Manrope', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;

  /* Spacing System */
  --container-max: 1320px;
  --container-padding: 2rem;
  --section-padding: 120px 0;
  --section-padding-sm: 80px 0;

  /* Transitions */
  --transition-fast: 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94);
  --transition-smooth: 0.45s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);
  --transition-slow: 0.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

  /* Shadows & Radius */
  --shadow-subtle: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
  --shadow-card: 0 15px 35px rgba(33, 7, 8, 0.08);
  --shadow-dark: 0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
  --radius-sm: 2px;
  --radius-md: 4px;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   02. BASE RESETS & TYPOGRAPHY
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
*, *::before, *::after {
  box-sizing: border-box;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
}

html {
  font-size: 16px;
  scroll-behavior: smooth;
  -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased;
  -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale;
}

body {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--color-text-dark);
  background-color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  overflow-x: hidden;
}

/* Scrollbar */
::-webkit-scrollbar {
  width: 8px;
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
  background: var(--color-burgundy-dark);
}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
  background: var(--color-gold);
  border-radius: 4px;
}

img {
  max-width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}

a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
  transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

button, input, select, textarea {
  font-family: inherit;
  font-size: inherit;
  outline: none;
}

/* Typography Scale — All Headings Italic Weight 300 */
h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6,
.hero-title, .section-title, .philosophy-headline,
.story-title, .craft-title, .step-card-title,
.product-title, .tier-name, .why-title,
.pillar-title, .contact-title, .signature-name,
.stat-number, .tier-roman-num, .craft-row-num, .pillar-num, .step-card-num {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-weight: 300 !important;
  font-style: italic !important;
  line-height: 1.15;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
  color: inherit;
}

h1 { font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); }
h2 { font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.8vw, 3.25rem); }
h3 { font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 2.5vw, 2.25rem); }
h4 { font-size: clamp(1.25rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem); }

em, .italic-accent {
  font-style: italic;
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-weight: 300 !important;
}

.text-gold {
  color: var(--color-gold) !important;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   03. REUSABLE ELEMENTOR-FRIENDLY UTILITIES
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.container, .vm-container, .vittorio-site-wrapper .container {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: var(--container-max);
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
  padding-left: var(--container-padding);
  padding-right: var(--container-padding);
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.section, .vm-section, .vittorio-site-wrapper .section {
  padding: var(--section-padding);
  position: relative;
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.bg-burgundy {
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy);
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
}

.bg-burgundy-dark {
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy-dark);
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
}

.bg-ivory {
  background-color: var(--color-ivory);
  color: var(--color-text-dark);
}

.bg-ivory-light {
  background-color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  color: var(--color-text-dark);
}

/* Section Header Structure */
.section-header {
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
  position: relative;
}

.section-header.text-center {
  text-align: center;
}

.section-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  color: var(--color-gold);
  margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
  display: block;
}

.section-title {
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.section-description {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  max-width: 680px;
  line-height: 1.7;
}

.section-header.text-center .section-description {
  margin-left: auto;
  margin-right: auto;
}

.bg-burgundy .section-description {
  color: var(--color-text-ivory-subtle);
}

/* Luxury Divider Lines */
.gold-divider {
  width: 60px;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: var(--color-gold);
  margin: 1.5rem 0;
}

.gold-divider.center {
  margin: 1.5rem auto;
}

.gold-crest-icon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  margin-bottom: 1rem;
  opacity: 0.85;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   04. BUTTON WIDGETS (ELEMENTOR BUTTON COMPATIBILITY)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.btn {
  display: inline-flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 0.65rem;
  padding: 0.85rem 1.85rem;
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.725rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
  border: 1px solid transparent;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.btn-sm {
  padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem !important;
  font-size: 0.65rem !important;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em !important;
}

.btn-gold {
  background-color: var(--color-gold);
  color: var(--color-burgundy-dark);
  border-color: var(--color-gold);
}

.btn-gold:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-gold-light);
  border-color: var(--color-gold-light);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.3);
}

.btn-outline-gold {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--color-gold);
  border-color: var(--color-gold-border);
}

.btn-outline-gold:hover {
  background-color: var(--color-gold);
  color: var(--color-burgundy-dark);
  border-color: var(--color-gold);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-burgundy {
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy-btn);
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  border-color: var(--color-gold-border);
}

.btn-burgundy:hover {
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy-btn-hover);
  border-color: var(--color-gold);
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
  box-shadow: 0 8px 25px rgba(96, 12, 3, 0.4);
}

.btn-outline-dark {
  background-color: transparent;
  color: var(--color-text-dark);
  border-color: var(--color-border-light);
}

.btn-outline-dark:hover {
  border-color: var(--color-gold);
  color: var(--color-gold-dark);
  transform: translateY(-2px);
}

.btn-arrow {
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.btn:hover .btn-arrow {
  transform: translateX(4px);
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   05. HEADER & NAVIGATION
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* WP Admin Bar Compatibility */
body.admin-bar .site-header,
.admin-bar .site-header {
  top: 32px;
}

@media (max-width: 782px) {
  body.admin-bar .site-header,
  .admin-bar .site-header {
    top: 46px;
  }
}

.site-header {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  box-sizing: border-box;
  z-index: 1000;
  padding: 1.5rem 0;
  transition: var(--transition-smooth);
}

.site-header.scrolled {
  padding: 1rem 0;
  background-color: rgba(56, 6, 1, 0.95);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gold-subtle);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-dark);
}

.header-container {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: space-between;
}

/* Header Brand Logo */
.brand-logo {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.official-brand-logo {
  height: 52px;
  width: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 2px 8px rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.25));
  transition: transform var(--transition-fast);
}

.official-brand-logo:hover {
  transform: scale(1.03);
}

.hero-official-logo {
  height: 64px;
  width: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.3));
}

.footer-official-logo {
  height: 70px;
  width: auto;
  object-fit: contain;
  margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
}

/* Navigation Links */
.main-nav {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.35rem;
}

.nav-link {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  font-weight: 500;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  color: var(--color-ivory);
  position: relative;
  padding: 0.35rem 0;
}

.nav-link::after {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 0;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: var(--color-gold);
  transition: width var(--transition-fast);
}

.nav-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-gold);
}

.nav-link:hover::after {
  width: 100%;
}

.header-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
}

.header-actions .btn {
  padding: 0.55rem 1.25rem;
  font-size: 0.65rem;
  letter-spacing: 0.22em;
  border-color: rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.4);
}

.site-header.scrolled .header-actions .btn {
  padding: 0.5rem 1.15rem;
}

.phone-link {
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  color: var(--color-gold);
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}

.phone-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-ivory);
}

/* Mobile Navigation Toggle */
.mobile-nav-toggle {
  display: none;
  background: none;
  border: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  width: 30px;
  height: 24px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1010;
}

.hamburger-line {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: var(--color-gold);
  position: absolute;
  left: 0;
  transition: var(--transition-fast);
}

.hamburger-line:nth-child(1) { top: 3px; }
.hamburger-line:nth-child(2) { top: 11px; width: 75%; }
.hamburger-line:nth-child(3) { top: 19px; }

.mobile-nav-toggle.active .hamburger-line:nth-child(1) {
  top: 11px;
  transform: rotate(45deg);
}

.mobile-nav-toggle.active .hamburger-line:nth-child(2) {
  opacity: 0;
}

.mobile-nav-toggle.active .hamburger-line:nth-child(3) {
  top: 11px;
  transform: rotate(-45deg);
}

/* Mobile Nav Drawer */
.mobile-nav-drawer {
  position: fixed;
  top: 0;
  right: -100%;
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 420px;
  height: 100vh;
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy-dark);
  padding: 6rem 3rem 3rem;
  z-index: 1005;
  transition: right var(--transition-smooth);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--color-gold-border);
}

.mobile-nav-drawer.active {
  right: 0;
}

.mobile-menu-list {
  list-style: none;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.75rem;
}

.mobile-menu-link {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.75rem;
  color: var(--color-ivory);
  letter-spacing: 0.05em;
  display: block;
}

.mobile-menu-link:hover {
  color: var(--color-gold);
  padding-left: 0.5rem;
}

.mobile-drawer-footer {
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-gold-subtle);
  padding-top: 2rem;
  color: var(--color-text-ivory-subtle);
  font-size: 0.8rem;
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   06. SECTION 01 — HERO (ASYMMETRIC EDITORIAL SPLIT)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.section-hero {
  min-height: 100vh;
  padding: 140px 0 90px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  position: relative;
  background: var(--gradient-burgundy-radial);
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  overflow: hidden;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-gold-subtle);
}

.section-hero::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  top: -20%;
  left: -10%;
  width: 60%;
  height: 140%;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(201, 164, 92, 0.08) 0%, transparent 70%);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.hero-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.hero-text-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.hero-badge-group {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
}

.hero-crest-mini {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
}

.hero-eyebrow {
  font-family: var(--font-sans);
  font-size: 0.725rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.3em;
  color: var(--color-gold);
}

.hero-title {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 4.8vw, 4.65rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.12;
  color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.02em;
}

.hero-title em {
  color: var(--color-gold-light);
  font-style: italic;
}

.hero-subtitle {
  font-size: 1.05rem;
  font-weight: 300;
  color: var(--color-text-ivory-subtle);
  max-width: 620px;
  margin-bottom: 2.5rem;
  line-height: 1.75;
}

.hero-actions {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  margin-bottom: 3.5rem;
}

/* Embedded Hero Metrics Strip */
.hero-metrics-strip {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 2rem;
  padding-top: 2rem;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--color-gold-subtle);
  width: 100%;
}

.hero-metric-item {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.metric-val {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.65rem;
  color: var(--color-gold);
  line-height: 1;
}

.metric-lab {
  font-size: 0.625rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--color-ivory-muted);
  margin-top: 0.35rem;
}

.hero-metric-divider {
  width: 1px;
  height: 35px;
  background-color: var(--color-gold-subtle);
}

/* Right Column Portrait Frame */
.hero-image-col {
  position: relative;
}

.hero-portrait-frame {
  position: relative;
  width: 100%;
  padding-top: 125%; /* Aspect ratio */
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gold-border);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-dark);
}

.hero-portrait-img {
  position: absolute;
  top: 0;
  left: 0;
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  object-fit: cover;
  object-position: center top;
  transition: transform var(--transition-slow);
}

.hero-portrait-frame:hover .hero-portrait-img {
  transform: scale(1.05);
}

.hero-seal-badge {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 1.5rem;
  left: 1.5rem;
  background-color: rgba(20, 4, 5, 0.9);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gold);
  backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
  padding: 1rem 1.25rem;
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.85rem;
}

.seal-icon {
  width: 24px;
  height: 24px;
}

.seal-text {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.seal-title {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 0.95rem;
  color: var(--color-gold);
  line-height: 1;
}

.seal-sub {
  font-size: 0.55rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.2em;
  color: var(--color-ivory-muted);
  margin-top: 3px;
}

.hero-scroll-line {
  width: 1px;
  height: 40px;
  background: linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--color-gold), transparent);
  animation: scrollPulse 2s infinite;
}

@keyframes scrollPulse {
  0% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: top; }
  50% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: top; }
  51% { transform: scaleY(1); transform-origin: bottom; }
  100% { transform: scaleY(0); transform-origin: bottom; }
}

/* --------------------------------------------------------------------------
   07. SECTION 02 — BRAND PHILOSOPHY (ASYMMETRIC EDITORIAL MANIFESTO)
   -------------------------------------------------------------------------- */
.section-philosophy {
  background-color: var(--color-ivory-light);
  position: relative;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border-light);
}

.philosophy-split-container {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1.15fr 0.85fr;
  gap: 4rem;
  align-items: center;
}

.philosophy-manifesto-col {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: flex-start;
}

.philosophy-badge {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
  margin-bottom: 1.25rem;
}

.philosophy-headline {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: clamp(2rem, 3.5vw, 3.1rem);
  font-weight: 400;
  line-height: 1.2;
  color: var(--color-burgundy);
  margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
  letter-spacing: -0.01em;
}

.philosophy-headline em {
  color: var(--color-gold-dark);
  font-style: italic;
}

.philosophy-body {
  font-size: 1rem;
  color: var(--color-text-muted);
  line-height: 1.8;
  margin-bottom: 2.25rem;
}

.philosophy-signature-block {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1.25rem;
}

.signature-line {
  width: 40px;
  height: 1px;
  background-color: var(--color-gold-dark);
}

.signature-meta {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
}

.signature-name {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.2rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: var(--color-burgundy);
}

.signature-role {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  color: var(--color-gold-dark);
  margin-top: 2px;
}

/* Philosophy Right Card */
.philosophy-card-col {
  position: relative;
}

.philosophy-seal-card {
  background-color: var(--color-ivory);
  border: 1px solid var(--color-gold-border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
  padding: 3rem 2.25rem;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-subtle);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 1.5rem;
  position: relative;
}

.seal-card-tag {
  font-size: 0.6rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  letter-spacing: 0.25em;
  color: var(--color-gold-dark);
}

.seal-quote {
  font-family: var(--font-serif);
  font-size: 1.35rem;
  color: var(--color-burgundy);
  line-height: 1.5;
  font-style: italic;
}

.seal-guarantee {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.75rem;
